images.subject: A crystal mining complex, one towering multi-level industrial building built directly around the wide dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into the cliff face, with one massive conveyor carrying raw crystal out of the tunnel. On the right side of the frame, next to the tunnel, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a dedicated crystal refinery building with tall glass walls, through which rows of cut and polished pale blue crystals glow brightly.
images.detail: Huge clusters of pale blue crystal grow out of the exposed rock around the tunnel mouth.
images.state: Far-future high-tech mining machinery in active use, with composite panels and polished metal under a very light coat of rock dust, and bright floodlights switched on.
